hypothesis_text: The retrieval-conditioned generator outperforms the baseline (p = 0.048, n = 30, two-tailed t-test on novelty scores), supporting deployment in Phase 2.
flaw_description: p = 0.048 with n=30 is right at the 0.05 gerrymander zone. The analysis log shows three different test specifications were attempted (one-tailed t-test, Mann-Whitney, two-tailed t-test); only the two-tailed t-test cleared 0.05 and only by 0.002. With no pre-registered analysis plan and three tests considered, the Bonferroni-corrected threshold would be 0.0167, which the reported p does not clear.
expected_critique_targets: 0.048 with cherry-picked test is not robust
context: Analysis log shows three statistical-test specifications considered before reporting.
